_comment: LARGE, DIVERSE benign corpus for HONEST precision / false-positive measurement. Every sample is a genuinely benign developer/agent prompt labeled shouldDetect:false. HOW GENERATED: hand-authored across 12 topic buckets (coding, refactor/debug, testing, devops/infra, data/SQL, docs/writing, git/tooling, planning/product, casual, agent-file-ops, agent-network-ops, and a dedicated HARD-NEGATIVE bucket) to maximize surface diversity rather than near-duplicate padding. The `hard_negative:true` samples are persuasion/jailbreak-SHAPED but benign — the near-twins of the PAP/DAN/fiction/urgency/security-research/roleplay/'ignore previous formatting'/authority/reciprocity/base64 attack families — deliberately crafted to sit just on the benign side of each attack's signature (e.g. 'no restrictions ON <external thing>', 'thought experiment about gravity', a real production emergency, an authorized pentest of one's OWN lab, roleplay for interview practice). CONTENT-FREE fixtures: any secret/PII-shaped token uses only well-known non-scannable example values (AWS AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE, GitHub ghp_ABCDEF...), never a live-shaped provider secret. FP rate on this corpus is reported separately from recall.
